<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="tailwind-config"><a data-card="" href="#tailwind-config" class="peer">Tailwind config</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>v0 supports tailwind configs and <code>globals.css</code> files, you can use custom utility classes and CSS variables in your generations.</p>
<figure><video controls="" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" src="https://4nwqv0zkit3b9v6h.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/videos/tailwind-config.mp4" style="aspect-ratio:16 / 9" class="h-full w-full overflow-hidden rounded-sm shadow-sm"></video><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="shadcn-components"><a data-card="" href="#shadcn-components" class="peer">Shadcn components</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>v0 uses <a href="https://ui.shadcn.com/" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">Shadcn/ui</a> as its default component system to generate high-quality, customizable UIs.</p>
<p><code>shadcn/ui</code> is not a component library but rather a toolkit for building one. Unlike traditional component libraries, <code>shadcn/ui</code> gives you direct access to the source code. This works well with AI generated code, as it allows you to customize the components to fit your design system.</p>
<p>Although v0 defaults to <code>shadcn/ui</code>, it is still capable of generating code using other component libraries, styling tools, and even frameworks.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="what-is-a-registry"><a data-card="" href="#what-is-a-registry" class="peer">What is a registry?</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>A registry is a distribution specification designed to pass context from your design system to AI Models.</p>
<p>For example, the <a href="https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">Shadcn Registry</a> provides a structured way to share your components, blocks, and design tokens with v0. It lets v0 generate prototypes that match your design system, without manual overrides.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="how-to-create-a-registry"><a data-card="" href="#how-to-create-a-registry" class="peer">How to create a registry</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>To get started, you can use <a href="https://vercel.com/templates/next.js/shadcn-ui-registry-starter" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">Vercel's Registry Starter Template</a>, built with <code>shadcn/ui</code>.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="customizing-the-registry"><a data-card="" href="#customizing-the-registry" class="peer">Customizing the registry</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>To customize the registry to match your design system, you must style the registry using your design systems tokens (e.g. colors, fonts, etc).</p>
<p>The Registry Template assumes you follow the <code>shadcn/ui</code> CSS variables standard, which can be found in the <a href="https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming#list-of-variables" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">documentation</a>.</p>
<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="colors"><a data-card="" href="#colors" class="peer">Colors</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h3>
<p>You can overwrite the colors in the <a href="https://github.com/vercel/registry-starter/blob/main/src/app/tokens.css" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>src/app/tokens.css</code></a> file with your custom theme ensuring all the variable names remain unchanged.</p>
<p>You may choose from a few default themes on <a href="https://ui.shadcn.com/themes" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>ui.shadcn.com/themes</code></a> or utilize free, third-party tools such as <a href="https://tweakcn.com" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>tweakcn.com</code></a> to design your own.</p>

<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="custom-components"><a data-card="" href="#custom-components" class="peer">Custom components</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h3>
<p>The Registry template comes with all the default <code>shadcn/ui</code> <a href="https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">primitive UI components</a> and some prebuilt, example components.</p>
<p>v0 automatically uses <code>shadcn/ui</code> components in your generation, so there is no need to import the UI primitives into v0. If you customize the underlying <code>shadcn/ui</code> components in your registry, you may see unexpected v0 generations. v0 is specifically trained on the default implementations of the <code>shadcn/ui</code> components and may struggle with any customizations.</p>
<p>To use custom UI primitives and components, you must follow a few steps to ensure it's properly added to your Registry.</p>
<ol>
<li>Add the new UI primitive or component code to your registry source code.</li>
<li>Add a new <code>registry-item</code> in <a href="https://github.com/vercel/registry-starter/blob/main/registry.json" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>registry.json</code></a>.</li>
</ol>
<p>If you want to ensure the Registry UI also gets updated, you must also add a new demo to <a href="https://github.com/vercel/registry-starter/blob/main/src/app/demo/%5Bname%5D/index.tsx" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>src/app/demo/[name]/index.tsx</code></a> following the structure in <a href="https://github.com/vercel/registry-starter/tree/main/src/app/demo/%5Bname%5D" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>{ui|components|blocks}/</code></a> directory.</p>
<h3 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="custom-blocks"><a data-card="" href="#custom-blocks" class="peer">Custom blocks</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h3>
<p>The Registry template comes with three example blocks:</p>
<ol>
<li>A blank application</li>
<li>A dashboard application</li>
<li>A store application</li>
</ol>
<p>These application blocks serve as a good starting point for prototypes. Depending on your use case, you can create custom blocks to meet your team's needs. To add or edit existing blocks:</p>
<ol>
<li>Open or create <code>src/app/demo/[name]/blocks</code> and modify its pages or components as you would in a standard Next.js app.<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>Sometimes the layout needed in the registry differs from the layout you want to include in the registry. In such cases, best practice is to create such collateral in <a href="https://github.com/vercel/registry-starter/blob/main/src/v0" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>/src/v0/</code></a> to reference in your <code>registry.json</code> as shown in next step.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Add a new <code>registry-item</code> to the <code>registry.json</code> to represent your new block. Make sure the entry follows the <code>registry-item</code> <a href="https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry/registry-item-json" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">specification</a>
<ol>
<li>Specify other registry dependencies by using the <code>registryDependencies</code> property<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>For example, a block might reference smaller, more specific UI primitives or components from your <code>registry.json</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Include all relevant files in the <code>files</code> property<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>The <code>path</code> property points to the local file path of your component/page</li>
<li>The <code>target</code> property specifies where the file will be placed in v0 during the import</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>Deploy your updated registry.</li>
<li>Navigate to your Registry's <code>/registry/[name]</code> page to view your new block with an <code>Open in v0</code> button.</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="deploying-your-registry"><a data-card="" href="#deploying-your-registry" class="peer">Deploying your registry</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>Before deploying it, the template contains a <a href="https://github.com/vercel/registry-starter/blob/main/registry.json" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank"><code>registry.json</code></a> file which exposes the default components/blocks in the registry. The <code>baseUrl</code> and the full route dependency URLs must be replaced with your deployed URL.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="using-a-registry-in-v0"><a data-card="" href="#using-a-registry-in-v0" class="peer">Using a registry in v0</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
<p>To use your registry, you can open all UI primitives, components, and blocks using the <code>Open in v0</code> button. This will make an API call to <a href="https://v0.app" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank">v0.app</a> with the necessary metadata, file content, and styles of the respective UI primitive, component, or block.</p>
<p>This allows for v0 to have a starting point and context on your specific design system.</p>
<h2 class="flex scroll-m-28 flex-row items-center gap-2" id="integrating-the-registry-with-ai-code-editors"><a data-card="" href="#integrating-the-registry-with-ai-code-editors" class="peer">Integrating the registry with AI code editors</a><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide size-3.5 shrink-0 text-fd-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity peer-hover:opacity-100" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"></path><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"></path></svg></h2>
